tools.name: lambda_list_instances
tools.description: List your running GPU cloud instances (id, name, ip, status, region, instance_type, ssh_key_names, filesystems, jupyter_url). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instances.

tools.name: lambda_get_instance
tools.description: Get full details of a single instance by id (status, ip, region, instance_type, ssh/filesystem attachments, jupyter url, available actions). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instances/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_list_instance_types
tools.description: List all GPU instance types with their specs (vcpus, memory, storage, gpus), hourly price (price_cents_per_hour), and which regions currently have capacity available. Use this to pick region_name + instance_type_name before launching. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/instance-types.

tools.name: lambda_list_images
tools.description: List available machine images (id, name, family, version, region availability) that can be selected when launching an instance. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/images.

tools.name: lambda_list_filesystems
tools.description: List your persistent filesystems (id, name, region, status, created_at) that can be attached to instances at launch. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/file-systems.

tools.name: lambda_list_firewall_rules
tools.description: List the account's inbound firewall rules (protocol, port range, source CIDR, description). Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rules.

tools.name: lambda_list_firewall_rulesets
tools.description: List firewall rulesets (id, name, region, rules) that can be applied to instances. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rulesets.

tools.name: lambda_get_firewall_ruleset
tools.description: Get a single firewall ruleset by id. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/firewall-rulesets/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_list_audit_events
tools.description: List account audit-log events, optionally filtered by time window and resource type, with page_token pagination. Lambda Cloud REST: GET /api/v1/audit-events.

tools.name: lambda_launch_instance
tools.description: Launch one or more GPU cloud instances. COSTS MONEY: billing starts as soon as the instance boots (hourly rate per instance_type). Pick region_name + instance_type_name from lambda_list_instance_types (only regions with capacity available), and pass exactly one existing SSH key name in ssh_key_names

tools.name: lambda_restart_instances
tools.description: Restart one or more running instances by id (a reboot — the instances are NOT destroyed and billing continues). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/restart.

tools.name: lambda_terminate_instances
tools.description: Terminate (permanently destroy) one or more instances by id. This STOPS billing for them but DESTROYS the instances and any non-persistent data — persistent filesystems survive. Irreversible. Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instance-operations/terminate.

tools.name: lambda_update_instance
tools.description: Update a live instance's name and/or tags. Only provided fields are changed. Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/instances/{id}.

tools.name: lambda_create_filesystem
tools.description: Create a new persistent filesystem in a region (can then be attached to instances at launch). Lambda Cloud REST: POST /api/v1/filesystems.

tools.name: lambda_delete_filesystem
tools.description: Delete a persistent filesystem by id. Irreversible — DESTROYS all data on it. The filesystem must not be attached to any instance. Lambda Cloud REST: DELETE /api/v1/filesystems/{id}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lambda_list_instances" references sensitive artifacts (ssh_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lambda_get_instance · Private data: lambda_get_instance, lambda_list_filesystems, lambda_launch_instance · Public sink: lambda_launch_instance, lambda_restart_instances, lambda_terminate_instances, lambda_update_instance, lambda_create_filesystem · Destructive: lambda_terminate_instances, lambda_delete_filesystem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lambda_get_instance · Private data: lambda_get_instance, lambda_list_filesystems, lambda_launch_instance · Public sink: lambda_launch_instance, lambda_restart_instances, lambda_terminate_instances, lambda_update_instance, lambda_create_filesystem · Destructive: lambda_terminate_instances, lambda_delete_filesystem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
